critique: The frame is appropriately dark and within a deep violet palette, with no obvious hard emitter edge visible. However, the nebula itself is nearly imperceptible: there is only extremely faint, mostly uniform purple shading rather than readable soft cloud masses filling the composition. No meaningful layered gaseous structure or close-inspection grain is visible at this brightness. Only a t1 frame is present here, so evolution from t1 to t4 cannot be verified.

suggestions.why: Raise the very low particle brightness/opacity enough to reveal the existing oversized glow-sphere cloud structure while retaining a dark background-grade result.
Make the fine texture perceptible on close inspection once the cloud field is visible, without turning it into dominant coarse noise.
